content.json:
# JA4proxy Security Dashboard

Real-time visibility into JA4proxy TLS proxy decisions, threat intelligence, and operational health.

---

parameters.name: ProxyNode
parameters.query: JA4proxy_CL | summarize by tls_version_s | project value = tls_version_s, label = tls_version_s
parameters.label: TLS Version Filter

content.json:
## Section 1: SOC Analyst Real-Time View

Live connection decisions, high-risk IPs, and active threats in the current time window.

content.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    Allowed = countif(ja4proxy_action_s == 'allowed'),
    Blocked = countif(ja4proxy_action_s == 'blocked'),
    Banned = countif(ja4proxy_action_s == 'banned'),
    Tarpitted = countif(ja4proxy_action_s == 'tarpitted'),
    AvgRiskScore = round(avg(ja4proxy_risk_score_d), 1)
| project Total, Allowed, Blocked, Banned, Tarpitted, AvgRiskScore
content.title: Connection Decision Summary

content.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ja4proxy_action_s
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Connection Volume Over Time (5-min buckets)

content.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ja4proxy_action_s in ('blocked', 'banned')
| summarize BlockCount = count(), MaxScore = max(ja4proxy_risk_score_d) by source_ip_s, ja4proxy_country_code_s, ja4proxy_asn_org_s
| top 20 by BlockCount desc
| project SourceIP = source_ip_s, Country = ja4proxy_country_code_s, ASNOrg = ja4proxy_asn_org_s, BlockCount, MaxScore
content.title: Top 20 Blocked Source IPs

content.json:
---
## Section 2: Fingerprint Intelligence

JA4 TLS fingerprint analysis — fingerprint distribution, rotation patterns, and new fingerprints from known-bad infrastructure.

content.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(ja4proxy_fingerprint_s)
| summarize
    ConnectionCount = count(),
    UniqueIPs = dcount(source_ip_s),
    BlockRate = round(countif(ja4proxy_action_s in ('blocked', 'banned')) * 100.0 / count(), 1),
    AvgScore = round(avg(ja4proxy_risk_score_d), 1),
    TopASN = any(ja4proxy_asn_org_s)
    by ja4proxy_fingerprint_s
| top 30 by ConnectionCount desc
| project Fingerprint = ja4proxy_fingerprint_s, Connections = ConnectionCount, UniqueIPs, BlockRatePct = BlockRate, AvgScore, TopASN
content.title: JA4 Fingerprint Distribution (Top 30)

content.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ja4proxy_action_s in ('blocked', 'banned')
| summarize DistinctFingerprints = dcount(ja4proxy_fingerprint_s), BlockCount = count() by source_ip_s
| where DistinctFingerprints >= 2
| project SourceIP = source_ip_s, DistinctFingerprints, BlockCount
| top 20 by DistinctFingerprints desc
content.title: IPs with Multiple Blocked Fingerprints (Possible Tool Rotation)

content.json:
---
## Section 3: Management Summary

Operational health, dial settings, and risk score distribution for management reporting.

content.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize AvgDial = avg(ja4proxy_dial_d), MaxDial = max(ja4proxy_dial_d), MinDial = min(ja4proxy_dial_d) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| project TimeGenerated, AvgDial, MaxDial, MinDial
content.title: Proxy Dial Setting Over Time

content.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize count() by RiskBucket = case(
    ja4proxy_risk_score_d < 20,  '0-19 (Observe)',
    ja4proxy_risk_score_d < 35,  '20-34 (Flag)',
    ja4proxy_risk_score_d < 55,  '35-54 (Rate Limit)',
    ja4proxy_risk_score_d < 70,  '55-69 (Tarpit)',
    ja4proxy_risk_score_d < 85,  '70-84 (Block)',
    '85-100 (Ban)')
| order by RiskBucket asc
content.title: Risk Score Distribution by Action Bucket

content.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(ja4proxy_country_code_s)
| summarize ConnectionCount = count(), BlockCount = countif(ja4proxy_action_s in ('blocked', 'banned')) by ja4proxy_country_code_s
| extend BlockRate = round(todouble(BlockCount) / todouble(ConnectionCount) * 100, 1)
| top 20 by ConnectionCount desc
| project Country = ja4proxy_country_code_s, Connections = ConnectionCount, Blocks = BlockCount, BlockRatePct = BlockRate
content.title: Top 20 Countries by Connection Volume
